lines.speaker: Homeroom Teacher
lines.text: We need to talk about your submission.

lines.speaker: Homeroom Teacher
lines.text: Your motivation letter raised serious integrity concerns.

lines.speaker: Homeroom Teacher
lines.text: Because of that, I won't be reviewing any further documents from you.

lines.speaker: Homeroom Teacher
lines.text: You may still submit your paperwork to the secretary, but there will be no more feedback from me.
